verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Teams supports bots/agents that can be added to Teams and 'initiate and participate in conversations' within channels, with quickstart guidance to 'create an agent and chat with it,' plus supporting features like slash commands and message streaming that are used for triggering agent responses in conversations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the @mention trigger mechanism specifically and independent/hands-on confirmation that agents behave as first-class channel members when mentioned.
